name: hn
description: Fetch Hacker News posts, comments, and linked articles for analysis and comment drafting.

commands.description: Fetch post metadata (title, url, score, author, text) and top comments (up to 10, sorted by reply count)
Fetch and extract readable text from a URL (strips HTML, truncates to 6000 chars)

prompt_doc: Hacker News reader via `python3 integrations/hn/cli.py <cmd>`. Commands: `post <item_id_or_url>` (fetches HN post + top comments), `article <url>` (fetches + extracts readable text from linked article). Use `post` first to get context, then `article` on the linked URL if it's not a text post. Output is pre-formatted for token efficiency.
